name: smart-tiffin-box-dashboard
description: Modern IoT dashboard for ESP32-based Smart Tiffin Box monitoring system

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run upload
scripts.minify: npx html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --minify-css --minify-js index.html -o dist/index.html && npx clean-css-cli -o dist/css/style.css css/style.css && npx terser js/script.js -o dist/js/script.js

author: Smart Tiffin Box Team
